name: HubSpot
tagline: Project-based apps · Unverified installs · App Marketplace
verdict: Self-serve: build a project-based app and customers can install it with an unverified banner, no approval needed. Marketplace listing is optional and needs 3 live installs first; unlisted takes about 1–3 days.
needGuide: Yes. Use the 2025.2 or 2026.03 project platform (legacy public apps can't be created) and keep tier-dependent scopes optional.

auth.detail: Authorization-code flow at app.hubspot.com/oauth/authorize; the code is exchanged at /oauth/v3/token for access and refresh tokens. Access tokens are short-lived (about 30 minutes, likely; the page did not state it). PKCE is not documented. Production redirect URIs must be HTTPS; http://localhost is allowed for testing.

effort.timeToProduction: 1–3 days unlisted; about 3–10 weeks for a Marketplace listing (needs 3 live installs first)

approval.gate: No approval to install on arbitrary accounts: unlisted OAuth apps install with an 'unverified' or 'not reviewed' banner (verifying your domain softens it). A Marketplace listing is optional but needs at least 3 active unique installs from unaffiliated production accounts, the Technology Partner Program Agreement, OAuth as the only auth method, and review by Ecosystem Quality.
approval.when: Unlisted apps are not reviewed. A Marketplace listing is optional and is reviewed by Ecosystem Quality.

timeline.label: Install minimum
timeline.official: 3 active unique installs from unaffiliated production accounts

timeline.label: Whole process
timeline.official: Up to 60 days after feedback; one submission at a time

scopes.why: Required, optional and conditionally required scopes; tier-dependent scopes can fail installs, and listing review checks that every scope is used.

table.note: Listing review expects only scopes you use, plus a matching shared-data table

cost: Free developer account and test accounts; no listing fee found.

tiers.label: Unlisted app
tiers.note: No approval. Installs show an 'unverified' banner; verifying your domain softens it.

tiers.label: App Marketplace listing
tiers.note: Needs 3 active installs from unaffiliated production accounts first, then Ecosystem Quality review.

prerequisites: A HubSpot developer account under a company email, so the app isn't tied to one person.
The HubSpot CLI (v7.6.0 or newer) and a personal access key.
A developer test account (Development → Test accounts).
HTTPS production redirect URIs; http://localhost works for testing.
A verified domain, to soften the unverified-app banner.

registerAt.path: HubSpot CLI: hs account auth → hs project create (base: App; distribution: marketplace; auth: oauth) → hs project upload → hs project open → Auth tab for the client ID and secret. Legacy 'Create app' in the developer account is no longer available.

steps.do: Create a HubSpot developer account under a company email and install the HubSpot CLI (v7.6.0 or newer).
Run hs project create and choose App, distribution marketplace and auth oauth. Edit app-hsmeta.json with redirectUrls and scopes.
Keep requiredScopes minimal and move tier-dependent scopes to optionalScopes or conditionallyRequiredScopes.
Run hs project upload, open the project and copy the client ID and secret from the Auth tab into your server.
Create a developer test account and install through Distribution → test install. Run the OAuth flow end to end.
Verify your domain and publish the install URL to customers. Super Admins install.
Accept the Technology Partner Program Agreement, complete the listing fields and public docs, and submit after 3 active installs.

roles.team: Any developer with a HubSpot developer account; use a company-owned developer account so the app is not tied to one person. The CLI needs a personal access key.
roles.console: Developer account user management and project-level permissions exist but role details were not in the pages read.
roles.customer: Installer must be a Super Admin or hold Marketplace Access permission. Users without access to a required scope cannot install; optional scopes get dropped silently.

consoleRoles.can: User management and project-level permissions exist; role details weren't in the pages read.

customerExperience: The installer must be a Super Admin or hold the Marketplace Access permission.
Users without access to a required scope can't install.
Optional scopes are dropped silently when the account lacks the feature.
Unlisted apps install with an 'unverified' or 'not reviewed' banner.
testing: Free developer test accounts (Development → Test accounts); install via the project's Distribution tab and tick the box to allow an unverified app. hs project dev gives local development.
Install caps for unlisted apps are not documented in what was read.

blockers.problem: Legacy public apps can no longer be created
blockers.fix: Use projects on the 2025.2 or 2026.03 platform.

blockers.problem: Listing needs 3 active unique installs before review
blockers.fix: Run unlisted installs with early customers first.

blockers.problem: Over-requested scopes fail install for non-Super Admins or lower tiers
An AI connector that doesn't use user-level permissions may be refused listing

gotchas: Access tokens are short-lived (likely about 30 minutes; the docs read didn't state it), so refresh before calls.
PKCE isn't documented, so don't rely on it.
Production redirect URIs must be HTTPS; http://localhost is allowed only for testing.

automation.agentCan: Scaffold the project and app-hsmeta.json, run hs CLI upload commands, write OAuth and refresh code, draft listing copy, public setup docs and the shared-data table, run test API calls.
automation.humanMust: Create and log in to the developer account, accept the Technology Partner Program Agreement, verify the domain, and have a customer Super Admin install.

uncertain: The numeric install cap for unlisted apps.
The exact access-token lifetime and PKCE support.
